# Experience

## Public Health • Research • Leadership • Service

My professional development has been shaped by experiences that have strengthened my interest in public health, research, community engagement, and creating meaningful solutions to complex health challenges.

</div>

## Professional Experience

<div class="experience-timeline">

<div class="experience-card">

<div class="experience-icon">01</div>

### Public Health Research

**Research & Academic Projects**

My academic and research experiences have focused on understanding public health challenges through evidence-based research, data analysis, literature reviews, and interdisciplinary approaches.

My work has included exploring topics related to **environmental health, health equity, community health, sustainability, and access to healthcare**.

</div>

<div class="experience-card">

<div class="experience-icon">02</div>

### Data & Research

**R • RStudio • Data Visualization**

I have developed experience using R and RStudio to organize, analyze, and visualize public health data.

My work includes data cleaning, data transformation, descriptive analysis, and creating visualizations that communicate public health findings in an accessible way.

</div>

<div class="experience-card">

<div class="experience-icon">03</div>

### Environmental Health Research

**Environmental & Community Health**

My research interests include understanding how environmental conditions and infrastructure can affect community health.

Current areas of interest include **data centers, environmental exposures, energy and water use, air pollution, noise, sustainability, and environmental justice**.

</div>

<div class="experience-card">

<div class="experience-icon">04</div>

### Public Health Consulting Projects

**Research • Analysis • Recommendations**

I have worked on public health consulting projects that connect research evidence with organizational sustainability and community health.

One example is a packaging circular-economy health gap analysis examining **waste-worker safety, microplastic exposure, and community burden** within the context of packaging and recycling systems.

</div>

## What I'm Building Toward

My professional goal is to continue developing as a public health professional and emerging physician while building expertise at the intersection of **public health, environmental health, epidemiology, healthcare, and health equity**.

I am particularly interested in research and initiatives that connect evidence with practical solutions for communities.

> **Research provides the evidence. Service provides the purpose. Impact comes from connecting the two.**
